stepper() renders numbered workflow stages with automatic completed, active, and upcoming states—or explicit per-step status (completed, active, pending, error). { "type": "stepper", "title": "Agent Deployment Pipeline", "active": 2, "orientation": "horizontal", "steps": [ {"label": "Connect LLM", "description": "Provider verified"}, {"label": "Index Knowledge", "description": "420 docs embedded"}, {"label": "Run Evals", "description": "Checking accuracy"}, {"label": "Publish", "description": "Production deploy"} ] }

Parameter Type Description steps list[dict] Ordered steps (label, optional description and status: completed, active, pending, error). active int Zero-based active step index used when per-step status is omitted. orientation str "horizontal" (default, wraps on phone) or "vertical". title str Optional header above the stepper.
